messages:
Iris (AE): BankBridge wants a 30-day Dedicated POC in us-west-2. Requirements: dedicated endpoint, static egress IP(s) for firewall allowlist, and optional mTLS to authenticate their client. Procurement needs a single line item: '30-day Dedicated POC + mTLS ops'. Who owns cert rotation and what's the fastest start? cc @Omar @Luca

Omar (Solutions): We can do this. Two pricing options: single EIP for quick start (lower cost) or two EIPs for redundancy. mTLS on Dedicated requires ops to upload the customer's CA bundle; we charge a one-time setup fee. Need expected concurrency to price pool.

Luca (Network): Networking notes: outbound NAT uses allocated EIPs per pool. For allowlisting we provide /32s. We can also provide a DNS alias but recommend allowlisting IPs. TLS only via port 443 and SNI. If they want mTLS, they must provide CA chain in PEM and a rotation contact.

infra-bot: provisioning requested: small dedicated pool in us-west-2. ETA ~90 minutes. Reserving 2 EIPs unless customer confirms single.

Priya (Security): For procurement: we'll attach SOC2. mTLS responsibilities: customer provides CA bundle and handles cert rotation; they must notify ops 72 hours before rotation. If they use Private deployment they can manage TLS keys via KMS.

Omar (Solutions): Suggested POC flow: 1) Customer confirms single vs dual EIP and provides QPS. 2) If mTLS: send CA bundle + rotation plan. 3) We provision pool and hand off EIP(s). 4) Customer allowlists IPs on TCP 443 and smoke-tests with curl. If mTLS not ready, fallback to token auth + allowlist.

Luca (Network): Placeholder firewall rule to hand to customer: allow TCP 443 to 198.51.100.200/32 and 198.51.100.201/32 (placeholders until infra posts real IPs). Test command with POC key:
```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY' --resolve dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.example:443:198.51.100.200 'https://dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.example/v1/chat' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
```

Iris (AE): I'll ask BankBridge for QPS and whether they accept single-IP risk. Omar  please send the procurement line item ASAP. Luca/infra-bot  please post final EIP(s) in-thread when ready. Priya  please attach SOC2 and the short mTLS note. :thumbsup:
